leftOut: The series has no formal competition, elimination order, official winner, or season-long points standings; the fantasy game therefore scores observable social and personal events rather than competitive results.
The recurring distinction between full-time Housewives and friends of the cast affects their screen time and social access but does not constitute a formal team system.
Confessional commentary is frequently intercut with scenes from other times, so an individual reaction may appear in the same episode as an event without being recorded at the moment it occurred.
The reunion is a scheduled closing format with a moderator, seating arrangements, and questions about the season, rather than a vote, final challenge, or contest.
The show includes ongoing personal storylines involving marriage, divorce, family, money, business, and changing friendships, but these are not standardized challenges with uniform outcomes.
A cast member can appear less frequently, depart between seasons, or be reclassified as a recurring friend without an in-episode elimination ceremony.
The game cannot objectively measure sincerity, authenticity, social influence, fashion quality, or who is morally right in a disagreement; these remain subjective interpretations.

blocks.show: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
blocks.tagline: Luxury lifestyles, shifting friendships, and high-stakes social drama
blocks.premise: A group of affluent women in Beverly Hills share their personal lives, relationships, careers, family changes, social events, and conflicts on camera. Episodes move between private conversations, glamorous gatherings, group outings, and candid confessionals, with tensions and alliances evolving throughout the season. The season closes with a multi-part reunion in which the cast revisits unresolved disagreements and answers questions about the relationships portrayed on screen.

phases.name: Regular Season
phases.summary: The Housewives navigate individual life changes and group relationships through social gatherings, private conversations, celebrations, trips, and increasingly complicated interpersonal conflicts.

phases.name: Reunion
phases.summary: The cast gathers for a multipart reunion to revisit disagreements, challenge competing accounts of events, discuss damaged friendships, and address unresolved questions from the season.

finale.summary: The season concludes with the final installment of the reunion, bringing the season's relationship discussions and outstanding conflicts into a closing conversation rather than crowning a winner.

segments.name: Personal Life Scenes
segments.summary: A Housewife shares developments in her relationships, family, finances, career, home life, or personal plans, often revealing a new source of tension or vulnerability.

segments.name: One-on-One Conversations
segments.summary: Two Housewives discuss their relationship, exchange information, offer advice, revisit an earlier disagreement, or test whether trust can be restored.

segments.name: Social Events
segments.summary: The cast attends parties, dinners, celebrations, launches, and other gatherings where introductions, personal announcements, gossip, disagreements, and shifting social dynamics can emerge.

segments.name: Group Outings and Trips
segments.summary: Several Housewives spend time together away from their usual routines, creating opportunities for bonding, private side conversations, confrontations, and disputes that spill into the wider group.

segments.name: Confessionals
segments.summary: Individual cast members speak directly to the camera, offering personal interpretations, reactions, clarifications, and commentary that can contrast with what was said in group settings.

segments.name: Group Confrontations
segments.summary: Several Housewives address a disputed comment, suspected disloyalty, circulating information, or a damaged friendship, with the conversation potentially escalating or ending without resolution.

segments.name: Reunion Discussion
segments.summary: The cast sits together in a moderated setting to revisit season-long disagreements, compare accounts, respond to questions, and discuss the state of their relationships.

twists.name: New Cast Arrivals
twists.summary: New full-time cast members or recurring friends can enter the established social circle, bringing new relationships, perspectives, and potential sources of friction.
